turns.reply: Welcome to the gym! I have created a balanced 3-day full body routine for Monday, Wednesday, and Friday with a mix of compound and accessory exercises to get you started safely.

proposal.diff:
ADDED · Day 1 - Monday
  + Squat  1×10 @ no target
      note: Start with just the bar or a light weight to learn form.
  + Bench Press  1×10 @ no target
      note: Keep feet flat and elbows at about a 45-degree angle.
  + Barbell Row  1×10 @ no target
      note: Hinge at the hips and pull towards your lower ribs.
  + Overhead Press  1×10 @ no target
      note: Brace your core and press straight up.
  + Plank  1×3 @ no target
      note: Hold for 30 to 45 seconds per set.
ADDED · Day 2 - Wednesday
  + Deadlift  1×8 @ no target
      note: Keep your back straight and lift with your legs.
  + Lat Pulldown  1×10 @ no target
      note: Pull down to your upper chest.
  + Incline Dumbbell Press  1×10 @ no target
      note: Set bench to a slight incline.
  + Lateral Raise  1×12 @ no target
      note: Use light weights and control the movement.
  + Russian Twist  1×15 @ no target
      note: Focus on controlled rotation.
ADDED · Day 3 - Friday
  + Leg Press  1×10 @ no target
      note: Adjust seat so knees form a 90-degree angle at the bottom.
  + Dumbbell Press  1×10 @ no target
      note: Keep your wrists straight and press up.
  + Seated Cable Row  1×10 @ no target
      note: Keep your chest puffed out and pull to your belly button.
  + Romanian Deadlift  1×10 @ no target
      note: Push your hips back until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
  + Bicep Curl  1×12 @ no target
      note: Keep your elbows tucked at your sides.
